purpose: Teach: キックオフ/型式/買い取っ/アダプター/コネクタ/ブランク/送り出す/圏外

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、年度のキックオフミーティングを大切にしろ
lines.en: We need to take the fiscal year kickoff meeting seriously.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Steady tempo. Expectation embedded in tone, not volume. The voice of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の型式登録を更新します
lines.en: Understood. I'll update the product model registration.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient acknowledgment. Quick intake of breath at the start. Professional and present but not over-eager. The nod made audible.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧設備は買い取って頂ける業者を探せ
lines.en: Find a vendor who can buy our old equipment.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no softening. Clear beat on the verb. Businesslike pace. This is a task, not a suggestion. Slightly clipped.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内機器のアダプター在庫を整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the adapter inventory for our office equipment.
lines.style: Quick, assured response. Minimal tone colour — this is work being registered and filed mentally. Efficient and competent without flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、通信ケーブルのコネクタ品質を統一しろ
lines.en: Standardize the connector quality on our communication cables.
lines.style: Firm directive. Slight emphasis on 'standardize' — this matters for consistency. Even pace, no rush. Authority that expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人研修にブランク時間を入れます
lines.en: Understood. I'll incorporate break time into the new employee training.
lines.style: Brief, capable affirmation. Picks up the pace slightly from the boss's command. Notes it, will execute it. Professional and unquestioning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新製品を世に送り出す前にテストを徹底しろ
lines.en: Before we release any new product, make sure testing is thorough.
lines.style: Weighty final instruction. Slower pace on 'thorough' — this is the emphasis point. Serious undertone. This is non-negotiable expectation delivered calmly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社用携帯の圏外対策を検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review contingency measures for our company phones in low-signal areas.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Steady, competent tone. Slightly lower energy than the boss's statements but equally present. The reliable hand writing the note.
